title: India district profiles — source-backed records
description: District profile records are separated into verified field-bearing profiles and directory-identity-only shells. The LGD snapshot supplies names and administrative codes; it does not supply population, area, headquarters, economy or other district facts. Directory-only records remain verification_pending until those fields are sourced.
sourcePolicy: Each populated field must be supported by a district administration or other authoritative government source. Historical demographic figures must retain their Census reference year and boundary basis.
